10:89.text: Allâh said: "Verily, the invocation of you both is accepted. So you both keep to the Straight Way
(i.e. keep on doing good deeds and preaching Allâh’s Message with patience)
, and follow not the path of those who know not
(the truth i.e. to believe in the Oneness of Allâh, and also to believe in the Reward of Allâh: Paradise)

10:90.text: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Fir‘aun
with his hosts followed them in oppression and enmity, till when drowning overtook him, he said: "I believe that none has the right to be worshipped but He
in Whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am one of the Muslims

10:91.text: while you refused to believe before and you were one of the Mufsidûn

10:92.text: So this day We shall deliver your
that you may be a sign to those who come after you! And verily, many among mankind are heedless of Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)

10:93.text: And indeed We settled the Children of Israel in an honourable dwelling place
, and provided them with good things, and they differed not until the knowledge came to them. Verily, Allâh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection in that in which they used to differ.

10:94.text: are in doubt concerning that which We have revealed unto you,
[i.e. that your name is written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)]
, then ask those who are reading the Book
before you. Verily, the truth has come to you from your Lord. So be not of those who doubt

10:95.text: And be not one of those who belie the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of Allâh, for then you shall be one of the losers.

10:96.text: Truly! Those, against whom the Word
of your Lord has been justified, will not believe.

10:97.text: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful torment.
